Limbus Company
Left side is your sinner and right side is the enemy
- Each Sinner has 1 Action Slot displayed above their head
Below this is the Dashboard
- Each Action Slot is shown with 2 skill and the sinner portrait

In Unfocused Encounter (generic filler fight)
You drag from the chain in the left across each skill you wanted to play

In Focused Encounter
You can select each individual skill to each enemy's action slot

Each Sinner has Speed range which are randomly rolled every turn

For a turn to start, EVERY action slot much target another action slot

There's 2 outcome of Action slot targeting each other
- Clashing: If both skill slot align with each other, you enter a "clash". If enemy doesn't target back, if you have higher speed than opponent, you'll force enemy to target this unit
- Unopposed Attack: When you attack enemy but enemy has nothing to clash back
KJH is good at story writing
but isn't that good at designing fight

Skill on second picture

When Clashing or attacking, they goes by same way of flipping coin

Start with Base Power
Roll the coins by amount of coin inside each skill
- Heads: Coin Power is added/subtracted to Final power
- Tails: Power won't change

During Clash:
- Both side will roll all their coin them both skill are compared to each other
- Higher power win the clash and loser's coin is taken away
- Repeats until one side cannot clash anymore

During Attacking
- Roll each coin individually, each coin is tied to an attack
- Power determine the damage
Okay so it's kind of turn based  then
With some rng for your stat checks

Image from the Wiki
- The grey circle with blue number represent "Sanity"
- Each point of sanity adds to Headhit chance
- Sanity can range from -45 to 45 which means your Headhit chance ranges from 5% to 95%

White bar represent "stagger threshold"
When HP drop below stagger threshold, your sinner will became staggered for Current turn and next turn
- All Physical (Slash, Pierce, Blunt) resist will became Fatal (2.0x)
- Your sinner will NOT be able to act while staggered

Sin
- Represented by 7 colors
- Wrath, Lust, Sloth, Gluttony, Gloom, Pride, Envy
- Each time a skill is used, sin of their respective color is added to the owned tabs (Ex, Orange Skill give Lust)

Resonance
- When there's multiple skills of same color IN THE DASHBOARD, this is resonance
- Resonance effect boost skill the further right they are

Absolute Resonance
- When there's multiple skills of same color aligned NEXT to each other, it became absolute Resonance MASSIVELY increasing power of your skill

Where did you even get that info from

Defense Skill
- when tapping sinner portrait below the skill, your Bottomost skill will be replaced with defense skill
- Each Identity has their own type of defense skill
- Guard - Gain Shield by Power
- Evade - If Power > Upcoming Attack, doesn't take damage
- Counter - After getting hit, attack back
- Clashable Guard - If Power < Upcoming attack, reduce POWER OF ENEMY ATTACK by Final Power
- Clashable Counter - ANY skill coming to this unit will be clashed with regardless of speed

Passive 
- Shown in leftmost side of the screen
- Every sinner onfield has onfield Passive and Every Sinner off field has Support Passive
- Passive can be triggered by either (depending on passive)
• Own certain amount of Sin
• Getting certain amount of Reson
